trickyParts: An all-on-PR merge stays `internal` before any git call; every other merge fetches its parents first, and a parent still missing makes it `forward` with conflicts null and error 'parent object missing' (no ancestry call).
The window filter applies only to runs with `selection`; the Python records are read as they are, so P1 is unchanged. Runs without `closedAt` (earlier live runs) keep CLOSED PRs.
summarise owns the glob matching and returns fixPairs; classifyFixes computes ancestry for those pairs only; applyFixStates is pure.
deviations: Raw records gain `closedAt` (after `createdAt`), read from GitHub; absent from the Python run's records.
